decisions.reason: Adding a subtle header to internal pages does not change the footer requirement; the client separately states that the existing footer works well.
The internal-header content includes a confidentiality label but does not change the independently specified final-page distribution warning.
The candidate already has a message-42 MODIFY requiring RR-01 throughout and explicitly including the internal-page header, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
The new header applies to pages 2 onwards and does not alter the front-page dashboard's score, heading, fields, or prominence.
The suggested internal-page header does not necessarily change which customer-specific fields are editable or how the assessment date and vehicle identity are presented.
The internal-page header decision does not change the content or scannable presentation of the front-page result explanation.
The broad visual-style requirement already captures the source message's overall refinement direction; the specific internal-header change does not require another propagated state update.
The internal-page header neither changes report-variant selection nor modifies risk-band or exposure-level mapping.
Adding and styling an internal-page header does not alter the required fonts, icons, design assets, or handoff obligation.
The header refinement does not change the required report variants, source-file editability, PDF export support, or format selection.
